title_candidates: ChatGPT gives free users unlimited text chats and a new Think button
summary: OpenAI is moving free ChatGPT accounts to GPT-5.6 Luna with unlimited text chats, while paid users get a revised GPT-5.6 Sol and a reasoning slider.

primary_source.title: Improving GPT-5.6 Sol in ChatGPT and expanding access to GPT-5.6 Luna for free users
primary_source.author: OpenAI
key_facts: Plus and Pro users receive an updated GPT-5.6 Sol in ChatGPT and a slider for choosing reasoning effort.
Free and Go users are moving to GPT-5.6 Luna as the default model during the week of August 6.
OpenAI plans unlimited text chats and a Think button for Free and Go users starting the following week, subject to abuse controls.
File uploads, images, and other tools retain separate limits.
The GPT-5.6 Sol version used by Work and Codex is not changing in this update.

prerequisites: One non-sensitive planning question you can check yourself

steps.instruction: Check which model and reasoning controls are visible in a new ChatGPT conversation; staged rollout means some accounts will not have them yet.
Compare one checkable planning prompt at normal and higher reasoning effort, then independently verify current or high-stakes facts.

risk_flags: Unlimited access applies to text chats; tools retain separate limits.
